derivation: abs(1/(x-0.5)) >= 1e6 exactly when abs(x-0.5) <= 1e-6, which is the declared bound failing. The region is one millionth wide on each side of 0.5, so this entry measures atlas resolution rather than detection.

regions.reason: the declared magnitude bound is exceeded

expect: a very narrow band; a coarse atlas may miss it entirely and should report UNKNOWN rather than TRUSTED
